profile.headline: Software Engineer | Beep booper of computers
profile.summary:
I am a problem-solver who thrives in environments that prioritize teamwork that encourages continuous learning and collaboration. I strive to build scalable, maintainable apps that make the lives of end-users better.

After taking a circuitous route in various roles and industries, from marketing to nonprofit/education administration, I am now working with my first love, technology.

Tools in my Toolbelt: 
TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Node.js, SQL, NoSQL, GraphQL
React.js, React Query (pretty much a fan girl of all of Tanstack), Redux (prefer Zustand or Jotai, though not many things need to be in global state), Spring Boot, Tailwind, Material UI (and other component library, though I prefer to scaffold off accessible primitive libraries and build my own), Prisma, tRpc (t3 stack is super fun!)

I've also been dabbling in Elixir/Phoenix. I love functional programming! Random tidbit, I am kind of addicted to jigsaw puzzles.

positions.description: Delight customers with great UX + make it accessible for everyone

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
React, typescript, react-query, redux, tailwind.

Having a ton of fun building features for an awesome product. 🌈 Stavvy is a Fintech company in the mortgage space.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on migration of Cengage's B2C eCommerce platform to a headless SPA with React and NextJS (from AngularJS).
Made contributions to various Java Spring Boot microservices and built custom components for Java based CMS.

positions.title: Administrator, Registration & Exams
positions.description:
Managed proctors and temp/seasonal workers for exams: includes hiring, training, scheduling, and providing feedback.
Wrote queries for reporting and analysis related to course registration, ran the course selection process, and provided student advising. 
Managed all aspects of exams at HLS from software configuration and technical troubleshooting, hiring and managing proctors, training/demo on software, intake and distribution of prompts and student submissions, to general planning and logistics. All HLS exams are anonymously graded and taken through the Exam4 software.
Developed training course for students on the E4 software.

positions.title: Online Marketing Consultant
positions.description:
- Hired, managed, and assigned work to contractors in creating marketing sites, creative assets and materials.
- Managed online marketing campaigns (SEO, Paid Search, Social Media) within a range of budgets.
- Implemented and automated online marketing campaigns and established core metrics to measure campaign health. 
- Identified new channels and strategies to increase KPIs. 
- Audit sites for code issues, content opportunities, and internal linking.

positions.title: Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, and configured Wordpress (v2-3) and static sites with a speciality in e-commerce with WooCommerce.
- Developed and configured custom Wordpress plugins. 
- Detailed attention to SEO with specialization in Local Online Marketing.

positions.title: Data Specialist, Registration & Enrollment
positions.description:
Registration & Enrollment Administration - Provided district-wide registration intake and enrollment management in Aspen SIS for over 6,900 active students; monitored data processes in compliance with FERPA and to ensure accurate student records for DOE reporting. Developed various SQL queries, functions, and procedures in SIS database to provide statistical and narrative reports related to enrollment data.

Office Management - Hire, trained, supervised seasonal and existing staff on the student registration intake process. Maintained departmental web presence. Involved in creation of automated online systems to streamline departmental procedures, significantly decreasing phone call and walk-in inquiries. Evaluated and coordinated processes for departmental operational efficiency and scale.

Pre-School Program Lottery - Executed the lottery placement algorithm for the CPS Pre-School Program Lottery with over 350 applications annually; provided assignment notification, developed and managed waitlists.

Other Duties - Served as a Designated School Official (DSO) with the Federal Student and Exchange Visitor Program (SEVP) for foreign exchange applicants to CRLS. Was the Appeals Manager and facilitator for families who wished to appeal school assignments; investigated cases and compiled post-hearing decisions and results.

positions.title: Data Associate, QA/Compliance & Development
positions.description:
Data Management - Maintained integrity and accuracy of the MA Social Assistance Management System (SAMS); created SQL queries to analyze and improve tracking and reporting. Managed separate donor database; developed giving reports, financial campaign analysis, client sentiment reporting. Oversaw all aspects of client survey campaigns, from generating mailing lists, data collection, reporting, and analysis. Developed new survey design and procedures to increase response rate, using a 5 point Likert scale for improvements in statistical analysis and reporting. 

Volunteer Management - Trained, supervised, and delegated tasks to volunteers in data entry and records administration. The records were used to audit vendors and provide data to create statistical analysis for MVES to make informed decisions on our programs. 

Quality Assurance & Compliance - Conducted data audits on hundreds of providers and vendors to ensure compliance with the Massachusetts Executive Office of Elder Affairs’ regulations, including in-person auditing; generated post-audit reports for State submission. Service satisfaction reporting; tracked complaints and escalated issues to the proper channels.

Fund Development - Managed the growth of donor base and planned giving prospects through research, cultivation, and recognition activities. Coordinated quarterly direct mail fundraising appeal letters and all other direct mail campaigns. Researched and generated data for grant applications, monitor grants compliance and programmatic responsibilities.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Office Management - Supervised 2 direct reports, assigned tasks pertaining to customer outreach, customer scheduling, and online marketing advertising and sales. Processed monthly accounts payable and accounts receivable statements to ensure proper balance. Issued invoices, payments, and payroll for each project. 

Project Management - Simultaneously managed multiple client projects with varied scope and budgets. Organized work schedules and provided team support during client projects. Researched for supplies and building materials and submitted orders based on project requests and needs. 

Business Development/Marketing - Oversaw online advertising and lead generation. Identified potential customers and developed relationships with clients to increase incoming leads by 23% from 2010-2011.  Updated content and provided general site maintenance in the WordPress CMS System.

positions.title: Marketing Analyst
positions.locationName: Cayan, Formerly Merchant Warehouse (acq. by TSYS), Greater Boston Area
positions.description:
Paid Search Marketing / Search Engine Marketing (SEM) - Managed a $15 million marketing budget. Conducted A|B and multivariate conversion tests on landing pages, ad copy, and other marketing creatives. Investigated, analyzed, and recovered over $77,000 from click fraud activity. 

Search Engine Optimization (SEO) - Conducted research and technical analysis on SEO performance, created ranking reports, and competitive site analyses. Audit sites for coding issues, content opportunities, and internal linking.

Affiliate Marketing - Spearheaded and created brand new Online Affiliate Program that resulted in a 30% increase in new leads. Cultivated and managed over 100 affiliates and grew program via member incentives.

Social Media - Led B2C social media campaigns, in Twitter and Facebook.

positions.title: Operations & Data Coordinator, Admissions
positions.description:
People Management - Recruited, interviewed, hired, trained, scheduled, supervised, and provided feedback for over 15 student employees each semester, including students part of the work-study program. With 5-8 workers in parallel, assigning appropriate workload depending on aptitude. The work included data entry for application and enrollment to be processed into PeopleSoft. These applications were used by admissions counselors to determine student acceptance into the University. I also developed and implemented a new employee training and assignment program in use of PeopleSoft systems.

Data Management - Processed over 7,600 undergraduate applications. Report generation and analysis on prospective applicants. Provided progress communication and excellent customer service to a diverse group of applicants, parents, inter-university offices, faculty, and staff.

Email Marketing Development - Created email marketing campaigns in HTML/CSS targeted to prospective students. Developed digital promotional materials and static sites for University marketing to high schools, prospective students, and their parents. Reported and analyzed campaign activity.
